prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are consistently helpful, delivering wins across all 3 tests (+3.3% average after noise correction).
finish, new_flow changes are generally helpful (+6.7% average after noise correction across 3 tests), producing 2 significant wins (+11.8% and +7.3%) and 1 test with no clear effect (+2.4%).
adoption, redesign changes did not work (-5.4% average after noise correction across 2 tests), resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-11.1%) and 1 test with no clear effect (+0.5%).
sign_in, reorder changes remain inconsistent across 2 tests, producing 1 significant win (+12.4%) and 1 significant loss (-7.2%).
Predictions remain inaccurate overall, frequently overestimating unsuccessful changes while underestimating unexpected wins.
Evidence is still thin for kinds of change with only 1 test (adoption copy/hint, choose_path redesign/reorder, home notification, sign_in hint/notification).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Controls Practice Tour: Adds an interactive guided practice flow to the home_intro screen where users practice calling, hiding, and dragging their pet before completing onboarding. (why: Support mails show multiple users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding, while finish new flows have proven +6.7% effective.)
1: [home, wait_info] Interactive Pet Trait Preview During Wait: Displays interactive trait preview cards and desktop interaction tips while the pet asset engine finishes loading on the waiting screen. (why: Wait info changes on the home step have consistently improved conversion (+3.3% average), and waiting has a long mean time of 2336s.)
2: [sign_in, layout] Account State Clarification Sign In Layout: Redesigns the sign_in screen to a split layout explicitly explaining how signing into an existing account recovers previously created pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating confusion around account linking.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Readiness Spotlight View: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout confirming desktop display permissions and offering an instant spawn test. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or app launch issues, and finish redesigns provide strong overall conversion boosts.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Launch Status Tracker: Replaces the static waiting status with real-time status steps showing asset compilation and screen overlay initialization. (why: Home wait_info improvements consistently drive positive conversion across past tests (+3.3% win rate).)
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Sync Reminder Hint: Adds a clear hint below sign-in options reminding returning users to log in with their original credentials to avoid creating duplicate blank accounts. (why: Address the 8 support tickets where users reported lost pets after signing in again under new or alternate accounts.)
6: [adoption, hint] Pet Creation Style Expectation Hint: Adds an explanatory hint on the upload_photos screen showing how uploaded photos convert into stylized 3D desktop pets. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation looking wrong or failing due to unclear visual conversion expectations.)
